hooks.text: 资源规划与建筑站位会解锁城镇设施之间的连锁效果
hooks.excerpt: It will take a combination of careful resource management and planning to acquire the right buildings for your town, along with clever positioning of your buildings to unlock surprising and potent effects.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 异步PVP要求城市连续守住16轮，同时允许不限时调整布局
hooks.excerpt: As your town grows, other players will attack with their own skyshards, and you’ll need to survive 16 rounds to win. Sometimes they’ll surprise you with a humbling defeat, but that’s the best way to learn! With asynchronous PVP , there’s absolutely no time pressure. You can take as long as you like to arrange your city perfectly.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 170多种建筑分属不同派系，各自提供科技、爆炸魔法或生存能力
hooks.excerpt: You’ll encounter even more factions with 170+ unique buildings that have diverse and formidable effects to discover.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
